tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Challenge to Assessment Order and GST DRC-07 dated 20.02.2025 regarding the alleged non-payment of outward GST liability on the free supply of steam. The matter is presently under litigation and is pending before the Joint/Additional Commissioner (Appeals), Kolhapur.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: The Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Kolhapur, Maharashtra
tax_litigation.status: Pursuant to the Order-in-Appeal (OIA) received on 09.06.2026, the contingent liability has been substantially reduced from Rs. 5.06 crore to Rs. 2.38 crore.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Adjudicating Authority proposed penalty based on GST audit under relevant provisions of the Acts, the said penalty has been confirmed u/s 73 of the GST laws on following grounds: 1. Non-Payment of outward tax liability on free supply of steam; and 2. Short reversal of input tax credit under rule 42 of CGST Rules, 2017
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Joint Commissioner of State Tax (Appeal), Kolhapur
tax_litigation.status: The Order issued by the Office of the Joint Commissioner of State Tax (Appeal), Kolhapur was received on 26.06.2025. Pursuant to the appellate order, the tax demand was significantly reduced from Rs. 2.73 crore to Rs. 82 lakh, and the penalty was reduced to Rs. 3.90 lakh. Further, an appeal has been filed before the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) on 30.03.2026.
